newsitem.title: USA: FelCor sees Q4 FFO rising 20 pct.
newsitem.headline: FelCor sees Q4 FFO rising 20 pct.

text.p: FelCor Suite Hotels Inc said Wednesday it expected funds from operations per fully-diluted common share and unit for the fourth quarter to increase by about 20 percent as compared to last year.
The company said the amount would nevertheless be about 10 percent below analysts' estimates of $0.67 for the quarter.
Bill McCalmont, a spokesman for the company, said FelCor reported earnings of $0.50 per share for the same period last year after a change in accounting. Before the changes, the figure was $0.51.

The company said in a statement that this year's growth in FFO per share stemmed from the expected growth in revenue per available suite in both its original 13 hotel portfolio and in the 10 former Crown Sterling Suite hotels.
The company also said it would pay fourth-quarter dividends of $0.50 per share on its common stock and of $0.4875 per share on its $1.95 Series A Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock.
The dividends will be payable on January 31 to holders of record at the close of business on December 30.
